sql: with target as (select id, kalshi_order_id, market_ticker, strategy, created_at from live_orders where strategy in ('Fmmsell10','Hmmsell10') and created_at >= '2026-09-16T00:00:00Z' and action='buy' and side='no') select 'orders' as metric, strategy as label, count(*) as n, min(created_at)::text as first_at, max(created_at)::text as last_at from target group by strategy union all select 'context', o.strategy, count(c.id), min(c.decided_at)::text,max(c.decided_at)::text from target o join execution_order_context c on c.live_order_id=o.id group by o.strategy union all select 'book_kind',b.kind,count(*),min(b.received_at)::text,max(b.received_at)::text from execution_book_events b where b.received_at >= '2026-09-16T00:00:00Z' group by b.kind union all select 'collector',kind,count(*),min(at)::text,max(at)::text from execution_collector_events where at>='2026-09-16T00:00:00Z' group by kind
